_description: Scenario catalogue for demos and manual testing (see README 'Demo script'). Answers are generated by an LLM, so check the expected key facts and sources rather than exact wording. Enter a name and email in the sidebar first.

scenarios.question: How do I reset my password?
Can I share my password with a colleague?
scenarios.note: internet_connectivity.txt may also be listed as a source; the app lists every retrieved file.

scenarios.question: What should a VPN support ticket include?

What is the capital of France?
scenarios.note: Not an IT support issue, so the agent must not draft a ticket.
